name: Clicklastica
author: DigiDepot

sections.description:
Clicklastica is a simple frontend content protection plugin for WordPress.

Once activated, it discourages casual content copying by disabling common actions such as right-click and text selection for website visitors.

There are no settings or configuration pages. The plugin works automatically after activation.

Administrators are never blocked and can use the site normally.

Features

  • Disables right-click and text selection for visitors
  • Runs only on the frontend
  • Never affects admin users
  • No settings, menus, or configuration
  • Lightweight and easy to use
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress site.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Visit your site as a non-logged-in user to see the effect.
sections.faq:
Why does it not block me when I test it?

Administrators are never blocked. To test the plugin, log out or open the site in an incognito/private window.

The plugin does not seem to work after activation

If your site uses hosting, browser, or CDN caching, clear the cache and then test again as a visitor.
